tasks.gr12-mid-latitude-cyclones-t1: Topic: Mid-latitude cyclones. Cover the polar front, warm sector, cold front, occluded front, westerlies, the life cycle of a mid-latitude cyclone, and the weather changes that affect South Africa as fronts pass. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret synoptic charts, explain rainfall patterns, or compare front-related weather conditions.
tasks.gr12-tropical-cyclones-anticyclones-t1: Topic: Tropical cyclones and anticyclones. Cover the conditions needed for tropical cyclone formation, the eye and eyewall, hazards such as storm surge and flooding, and the subsiding dry air found in anticyclones over southern Africa. Ask Grade 12 learners to compare pressure systems or explain tropical storm impacts.
tasks.gr12-local-climates-t1: Topic: Local climates. Cover valley climates, slope aspect, mountain and valley breezes, temperature inversions, frost pockets, urban heat islands, pollution domes, and how land use changes local weather. Ask Grade 12 learners to explain microclimate differences or interpret settlement choices.
tasks.gr12-fluvial-processes-catchment-managem: Topic: Fluvial processes and catchment management. Cover drainage basins, watersheds, tributaries, stream order, river erosion, transport and deposition, drainage patterns, and catchment management in South Africa. Ask Grade 12 learners to interpret river diagrams or explain flood-control strategies.
